Users who rely on ChatGPT for quick image searches can now use a new gesture to add photos to conversations even faster. Here's how it works.

ChatGPT makes it easier to attach recent photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been available for nearly two years, it still only works on newer iPhone models and is not available in every region.

For users who rely on ChatGPT to perform similar image searches, previously to attach a photo, they had to tap "+", then tap "Photos", and then select an image from the photo library.

Although this process is not overly complicated, OpenAI this week added a practical new gesture that allows users to add their most recent photos to conversations more quickly.

According to OpenAI's Adam Fry on X, users can now long-press the "+" button on the left side of the input box to bring up the four most recent photos.

Users can then select a photo to attach to the conversation and ask questions or use it as part of their prompt.

This new gesture was rolled out alongside several other ChatGPT improvements this week, including more accurate awareness of the current time, faster loading and execution of long conversations on the web version, and clearer interface prompts when users are waiting for a network connection.

Would you use AI for image searching? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
